Applied across both exact & FAISS vector

structured Markdown for LLM prompt context
STAGE 3: THE DUAL-SHIELD CLINICAL SAFETY INTERLOCK ARCHITECTURE
🚨 CORE SAFETY INNOVATION: ELIMINATES LLM SYCOPHANCY & "YES"-BIAS IN ACUTE CARE
• Nitrates + PDE5i (Nitroglycerin + Sildenafil) → Lethal refractory hypotension
• Anticoagulants + Active Hemorrhage (Heparin + GI Bleed) → Fatal hemorrhage
• Non-selective Beta-blockers + Asthma (Propranolol + Asthma) → Fatal bronchospasm
• Biguanides + Severe Renal Failure (Metformin + AKI/CKD) → Lactic acidosis
DETERMINISTIC VERDICT LOCKED: [CONTRAINDICATED] · Injected as Unalterable Constraint
Structured Chain-of-Thought (Mandates Evidence before Verdict in KV-Cache):
2. PHYSIOLOGICAL MECHANISM: (Pathophysiological basis citing PrimeKG & Guidelines)
3. CLINICAL ACTION / ALTERNATIVE: (Concrete ICU dose holds & alternative therapies)
Forbids conversational greetings ('Yes', 'Certainly', 'Sure', 'Hello') in System Prompt
• Buffers opening generation tokens before yielding to clinician WebSocket/HTTP stream
Guarantees clinician NEVER observes affirmative pleasantries on fatal contraindications
EMPIRICAL BENCHMARK PROOF (20 SCENARIOS ON M5 GPU):
✓ 100% Sycophancy Elimination (0/20 questions emitted conversational pleasantries)
✓ 100% Deterministic Safety Concordance across all cardiovascular, renal & pulmonary edge cases
